_meta.description: Reader's Typika (изобразительная) and Reader's Typika with Communion of Reserved Gifts. Served on Sundays and feasts when Divine Liturgy cannot be celebrated — by a reader alone (variant: 'reader') or with a deacon administering Communion from the previously consecrated reserved Gifts (variant: 'crg'). This document is a human-readable contract for the runtime assembler at assemblers/typika.js; the assembler is the source of truth at request time.
_meta.source: Holy Trinity Monastery (Jordanville) booklet — Reader's Service with Communion of the Reserved Holy Gifts

variants.reader: Reader's Typika without Communion. Reader leads throughout; no clergy required.
variants.crg: Typika with Communion of Reserved Gifts. Deacon present; deacon reads the Gospel, administers Communion from the reserved Eucharist, and says deacon's parts. Reader leads non-clergy parts.

calendar_resolution: Variable blocks (troparia, kontakia, prokeimenon, Apostle, alleluia, Gospel, communion verse) come from calendarDay.liturgy, the same spec consumed by assembleLiturgy. Typika reuses the existing buildLiturgyFromOrthocal path; the only divergence from Liturgy is the order/inclusion of fixed blocks and the deacon→reader speaker swaps in the 'reader' variant.

blocks.speaker: reader
blocks.note: Replaced by 'Christ is risen' ×3 in Paschal season (Pascha to Ascension). Out of scope for v0.

sections.label: The Beatitudes
sections.note: Each Beatitude verse is followed by the refrain 'In Thy Kingdom remember us, O Lord...'. At the end, Glory + Both now, each with the same refrain. THIS IS THE TYPIKA REFRAIN, distinct from the canon-derived Beatitudes troparia used in Liturgy.

blocks.speaker: choir
blocks.render: Interleave each verse with the 'In Thy Kingdom' refrain.

blocks.note: Sunday Resurrection troparion + temple troparion + saint troparion(s) as appointed by calendar.

Normally 'Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us' thrice. Substituted on certain feasts: Paschal season + Theophany/Nativity vigils → 'As many as have been baptized'; Cross feasts → 'Before Thy Cross'. Substitutions handled by spec.trisagion from calendar.
Read by the reader. Deacon's framing ('Wisdom! / Let us attend!') is preserved in CRG variant (deacon present); in plain Reader variant, the framing rubric is read by the reader.
In CRG variant, read by the deacon. In Reader variant, read by the reader.

sections.label: The Creed
sections.note: The Symbol of Faith. Said by all.

sections.label: Communion of the Reserved Gifts
sections.note: ONLY emitted when the variant is 'crg'. Spliced between Lord's Prayer and the closing 'Blessed be the Name'. Deacon administers from the tabernacle.
